title: Christianity based TCG - Parabless
author: ParablessOfficial
selftext:
It's a Hearthstone type genre TCG with biblical pivot. It's not "Bible The Game." It has everything from life slotted into a certain framework.

Cards are divided into classes (7), alignments(Good, Neutral, Evil), factions(multiple), species(7) and forms(Spirit, Soul, Flesh & Craft).

We have early beta open so sign up. All game modes work. There's no money-spending in beta, everything is free.

You are welcome to download it in [Steam ](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4131830/Parabless/)(Win/Linux).

(Disclaimer, AI has been used in development.)
